whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Digital Food Mall DFM,

I noticed your cloud kitchen/food service has strong 4.7★ reviews in Yarpur, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile-friendly online ordering page.

Maine aapke food business ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp food ordering, menu showcase, aur instant delivery/pickup details integrate ki hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/dfm

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (DIGITAL FOOD MALL DFM) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp ordering and your menu showcase for customers in Yarpur, Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes, prices aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
